metadata.name: basket
metadata.description: basketlabs.fun factory program: creates baskets, share mints and program-owned vaults

instructions.name: apply_book
docs: Managed: open the window on the pending book once the timelock has
passed and the turnover fits the cap. Anyone.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; pays the creator share ATA if missing.

instructions.name: claim_pool_fees
docs: Claim one position's swap fees over `[min, max]` and route them. Anyone.

instructions.name: close_backstop
docs: Keeper: close the emptied backstop position.

instructions.name: close_basket
docs: Keeper: drain and close the tight position, burn leftovers, refund
the deposit and rent to the payer, close the Basket.

accounts.name: fee_vault
docs: Seeded baskets only. Stays open (see `close_fee_vault`).

instructions.name: close_fee_vault
docs: Keeper: reclaim the FeeVault's rent once everything is settled.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Keeper: remove an emptied position that left the book.

instructions.name: close_positions
docs: Keeper: close positions of a closable basket (dust to treasury, rent
to payer). Remaining accounts: `[position, vault, mint, treasury_ata]`
× `count`, then the tight range's bin arrays.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Pays treasury ATAs for dust if missing.

instructions.name: create_basket
docs: The deployer launches: Basket, share mint, metadata, DLMM pool, first
chunk of positions; posts the deposit. `attestation` is the optional
keeper-signed tier (ed25519 instruction right before this one).

accounts.name: payer
docs: The deployer: creator, payer of rent, and funder of the deposit.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: Share mint. PDA of (payer, nonce).

accounts.name: payer_wsol_ata
docs: The deployer's wSOL ATA (must exist; DLMM reads it and wants a
non-zero balance, topped up here if empty).

instructions.name: crystallize
docs: Managed only, once per period: management fee accrual plus the
performance fee above the HWM on a keeper-attested NAV.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Attests `nav_lamports_per_share`; must be in `config.keepers`.

instructions.name: execute_buyback
docs: Keeper: swap staged wSOL for $BSKT and burn it.

accounts.name: bskt_token_program
docs: The program owning `bskt_mint` (Token or Token-2022).

instructions.name: execute_swap
docs: Keeper: route one swap through an allow-listed venue with the
basket as authority. Remaining accounts: the inner instruction's.

accounts.name: pending_book
docs: reports `NoRebalance` rather than a deserialization error.

instructions.name: finalize_rebalance
docs: Keeper: walk the target book (chunked); the last chunk flips the book.

instructions.name: fund_backstop
docs: Keeper: deposit the idle sleeve's share for one bin array of the backstop.

instructions.name: init_treasury_vaults
docs: Admin: create the BUYBACK and PRIZE PDAs.

instructions.name: open_position
docs: Create the Position + vault for a pending-book mint. Anyone.

instructions.name: place_backstop
docs: Keeper: open the backstop position around the launch bin (or the
current one after a reset). Remaining accounts: its bin arrays.

instructions.name: post_prize_payout
docs: Keeper: pay one epoch's prizes. Remaining accounts:
`[creator_wallet, creator_lock, basket]` per recipient in rank order.

instructions.name: recenter_tight
docs: Keeper: move the tight position around the active bin. Remaining
accounts: old range's bin arrays, then the new range's.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Redeem `shares` (gross) for pro-rata components and the SOL leg in one tx.

instructions.name: redeem_begin
docs: Large books: burn + pool leg now, components in later `redeem_components` chunks.

accounts.name: redemption
docs: One open redemption per holder per basket.

instructions.name: set_bskt_mint
docs: Admin, once: the $BSKT mint `execute_buyback` burns into (Q8).

instructions.name: settle_fees
docs: Keeper: swap one FeeVault component ATA to SOL through an allow-listed
venue and route it. Remaining accounts: the inner instruction's.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: may already be closed).

accounts.name: in_ata
docs: The FeeVault's component token account being sold.

accounts.name: fee_vault_wsol_ata
docs: missing, closed onto the FeeVault afterwards.

instructions.name: stage_buyback
docs: Keeper: move BUYBACK SOL onto its wSOL account for `execute_buyback`.

accounts.name: buyback_wsol_ata
docs: ATA(buyback_vault, wSOL); the keeper creates it beforehand.

instructions.name: submit_book
docs: Propose a new book. Mirror/Strategy: keeper, window opens now.
Managed: creator, timelocked until `apply_book`. Remaining accounts:
`[mint, position, vault]` per entering mint.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Managed: the creator. Others: a keeper. Pays PendingBook rent and
any new Position + vault.

instructions.name: sweep_fees
docs: Creator's line in shares; the rest burned and redeemed in kind
(tight SOL leg routed now, components via `sweep_fees_components`). Anyone.

accounts.name: redemption
docs: The in-kind redemption of the protocol lines, paid out by
`sweep_fees_components`. One at a time per basket.

instructions.name: withdraw_backstop
docs: Keeper: withdraw one bin array of the backstop (reset or wind-down).

fields.name: position_rent_lamports
docs: Rent the keeper paid to grow the position over this array (refunded at close).

fields.name: profile
docs: `PROFILE_*`

fields.name: creator_tier
docs: Attested leaderboard tier at create (Q10).

fields.name: creator
docs: The deployer: signs `create_basket`, makes the first buy, gets the
deposit and rents back at close. Also `payer` (kept separate for the
indexer and for events).

fields.name: book_hash
docs: Commitment to the book (`CreateBasketArgs.book_hash`).

fields.name: book_acc
docs: Running chain hash while positions are being added.

fields.name: weight_acc
docs: Running weight sum while positions are being added.

fields.name: tight
docs: Re-centred by the keeper; where fills happen. Set at `seed`.

fields.name: backstop
docs: Placed once by the keeper after `seed`, whole bin arrays around the
launch bin; withdrawn only by `withdraw_backstop`.

fields.name: backstop_mask
docs: Bit per backstop bin array (from `backstop.lower_bin_id`'s array):
funded (FUNDING) or emptied (WITHDRAWING).

fields.name: deposit_lamports
docs: Change order §2.2: deployer's deposit held on this account, and the
non-refundable part (pool + bin-array rent) spent from it so far.

fields.name: fee_epoch
docs: Q9: pool-fee SOL claimed in the current and previous prize epochs.

fields.name: pending_redeem_shares
docs: Shares burned by `redeem_begin` whose components have not all been
paid out yet. Added back to the holder-share denominator so the
per-share vault ratio stays exact during a multi-tx redemption.

fields.name: hwm_nav_lamports
docs: D12: fund-level high-water mark in lamports per whole share
(`SHARE_DECIMALS`), and the last crystallization / management accrual.

fields.name: ready_at
docs: Managed: when the pending book can be applied.

types.name: BuybackVault
docs: `["buyback"]` (one per deployment). Accrues the buyback SOL line; it can
only ever be swapped into `Config.bskt_mint` and burned.

fields.name: cluster
docs: 0 mainnet, 1 devnet, 2 localnet. Part of the tier-attestation domain.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Squads vault that receives creation fees and close-time sleeve dust.

fields.name: team_wallet
docs: Receives the team fee line (change order §4). Squads vault on mainnet.

fields.name: whitelist_authority
docs: May edit the whitelist. Usually the admin, can be a hot key.

fields.name: swap_programs
docs: Programs `execute_swap` / `settle_fees` / `execute_buyback` may CPI
into (Jupiter v6 on mainnet). Empty = no swaps possible.

fields.name: rebalance_tolerance_bps
docs: Slack on the weight-derived per-position sell cap during a rebalance.

fields.name: deposit_lamports
docs: Deployer's refundable launch deposit (change order §2.2).

fields.name: allow_open_gate
docs: `MintGate::Open` is only accepted while this is set (ships false).

fields.name: bskt_mint
docs: Set once by `set_bskt_mint`; `execute_buyback` refuses while `None`.

fields.name: creator_tier_bps
docs: Creator fee line (bps of every fee event) by attested tier; tier 0 is
the base. The other three lines share the remainder pro rata.

types.name: ConfigUpdate
docs: Everything `initialize_config` / `update_config` accept. `None` keeps the
current (or default) value.

types.name: CreateBasketArgs
docs: What the deployer submits at "Launch" (frontend `buildLaunchParams()`).
The deployer signs `create_basket` directly (change order §2.2), so
there is no signed payload any more; `nonce` only salts the share mint
PDA so one wallet can launch more than once.
The asset list itself is not in the payload; `book_hash` commits to it
(chain hash, see `Basket::chain_hash`) and `add_positions` delivers it.

fields.name: fixed_kind
docs: `FIXED_KIND_*`, Fixed only; 0 otherwise.

fields.name: book_hash
docs: Chain hash over the ordered `(mint, weight_bps)` list.

fields.name: hosts_hash
docs: Mirror: sha256 over the ordered host wallet list. Zero otherwise.

fields.name: host_weighting
docs: Mirror: `HOST_WEIGHTING_*`. 0 otherwise.

fields.name: strategy_hash
docs: Strategy: sha256 of the assembled module. Zero otherwise.

fields.name: sleeve_r_bps
docs: Sleeve ratio after the step phase, within the profile band (§3).

fields.name: perf_fee_bps
docs: Managed: performance fee within `[0, perf_fee_max_bps]`. 0 otherwise.

fields.name: launch_active_id
docs: DLMM active bin at launch: one base share unit costs
`(1 + bin_step/10⁴)^launch_active_id` lamports. The client derives it
from the intended NAV per share; `seed` checks the first buy against it.

types.name: CreatorLock
docs: `["lock", share_mint]`. Creator's locked self-position (leaderboard skin).
Shares sit in ATA(CreatorLock, share_mint).

fields.name: creator_split_bps
docs: Four lines summing to `BPS_TOTAL` (change order §4).

types.name: FeeSchedule
docs: Per-basket fee schedule, copied from `Config` at creation (D11, §4,
change order §4). The four split lines sum to `BPS_TOTAL`.

fields.name: mgmt_fee_bps_per_year
docs: Managed only, else 0.

fields.name: perf_fee_bps
docs: Managed only, else 0.

types.name: FeeVault
docs: `["fees", share_mint]`. Holds the mint / redeem fee shares (in its share
ATA) until `sweep_fees`, the creator's SOL line when it could not be paid
out, and, between `sweep_fees` and `settle_fees`, the in-kind
components of the buyback / team / prize lines in its component ATAs.
Pool swap fees arrive as SOL and are routed straight through.

fields.name: creator
docs: Copied from the basket so `settle_fees` / `close_fee_vault` keep
working after `close_basket`.

fields.name: creator_owed_lamports
docs: Creator SOL line held back because paying it would have left the
creator wallet below rent exemption (a sweep must never revert on
the creator's account state). Paid on a later sweep.

fields.name: unrouted_lamports
docs: Pool fees the keeper claimed on the way through a re-centre or a
backstop withdrawal (those instructions do not carry the routing
accounts); routed by the next `claim_pool_fees`.

fields.name: swept_creator_shares
docs: Lifetime totals, for the indexer.

fields.name: unsettled_shares
docs: Fee shares redeemed in kind and still waiting for `settle_fees`.

fields.name: settled_shares
docs: The 80 % redeemed in kind into the FeeVault's component ATAs.

types.name: FrozenClaim
docs: `["claim", share_mint, wallet, mint]`. D10.

types.name: MintArgs
docs: `mint` (§5). Shares follow the creation-unit rule over `deposits`; the
active bin then prices the SOL leg. `min_shares_out` and
`max_sleeve_lamports` are the buyer's slippage bounds.

types.name: MintGate
docs: D6. Time-based, immutable after creation.

types.name: MintWindow
docs: Mint window bounds (change order §2.3). A creator's `WindowUntil` must
close between `min_s` and `max_s` after creation; `default_s` is what
the frontend pre-fills.

types.name: PendingBook
docs: `["pending", share_mint]`. Managed creator's timelocked book (§5).

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the rent (creator or keeper); refunded when the book is
finalized or replaced.

fields.name: ready_at
docs: Managed: `submitted_at + timelock`. Others: `submitted_at`.

fields.name: presets
docs: Indexed by `PROFILE_*`.

fields.name: recenter_trigger_bps
docs: Re-centre once the active bin is past this share of the half-width.

fields.name: recenter_min_interval_s
docs: Minimum interval between triggered re-centres of one basket.

fields.name: backstop_slice_bps
docs: Share of each sleeve deposit that goes to the backstop.

types.name: PoolParams
docs: The basket's DLMM pool (created in `create_basket`) and its preset.

types.name: PoolPreset
docs: DLMM pool preset per profile (progress §6.4a). The creator cannot
change these; tune on devnet.

fields.name: base_fee_bps
docs: Flat base fee of the pool.

fields.name: tight_half_width_bins
docs: `tight` = `[active − w, active + w]`.

fields.name: backstop_half_width_bins
docs: Backstop target half-width; the placed range is whole bin arrays
around the launch bin, at most `backstop_max_arrays` of them.

fields.name: reset_confirm_checks
docs: Keeper-side: consecutive out-of-range checks before `reset_backstop`.

fields.name: token_program
docs: Token or Token-2022 program that owns `mint`.

fields.name: vault
docs: ATA(basket, mint) under `token_program`.

fields.name: owed
docs: Component amount owed to holders through `FrozenClaim`s (D10). The
vault balance minus this is what pro-rata math uses.

fields.name: index
docs: Order in which the position entered the book; the chain hash follows
this order.

fields.name: rebalance_seq
docs: Rebalance in which `sold` was last accumulated (`Basket.rebalance.seq`).

fields.name: sold
docs: Amount sold out of this vault by `execute_swap` during that rebalance
(the per-position sell cap is cumulative over the window).

types.name: PositionArg
docs: One component in `add_positions` / `finalize_rebalance`.

types.name: PositionRef
docs: One DLMM position the basket PDA owns. `key` is the PDA
`["position", lb_pair, base, lower, width]` with base = basket (tight)
or share_auth (backstop). Zero until placed.

types.name: PrizeParams
docs: Deployer prize pool (change order §5, Q9).

fields.name: epoch_anchor_ts
docs: Epoch 0 starts here (set at `initialize_config`).

fields.name: split_bps
docs: Rank → share of the epoch's payout; the first `max_recipients` must
sum to `BPS_TOTAL`.

fields.name: min_epoch_pool_fees
docs: A recipient's basket must have claimed this much pool-fee SOL in the epoch.

types.name: PrizeVault
docs: `["prize"]` (one per deployment). Accrues the deployer-prize SOL line;
paid out by `post_prize_payout`.

fields.name: last_paid_epoch
docs: Highest epoch already paid; each epoch is paid at most once.

types.name: Rebalance
docs: State of an in-flight Mirror/Strategy/Managed rebalance.

fields.name: seq
docs: Incremented every time a rebalance starts; scopes `Position.sold`.

fields.name: target_hash
docs: Chain hash of the target book (the `PendingBook` holds the list).

fields.name: window_end_ts
docs: `execute_swap` is allowed until here; `finalize_rebalance` any time.

fields.name: acc_count
docs: `finalize_rebalance` progress: entries processed so far, running
chain hash and weight sum over them.

fields.name: turnover_window_start_ts
docs: Managed turnover accounting: bps of the book turned over in the window.

fields.name: complete
docs: False when components are still to be paid through `Redemption`.

types.name: Redemption
docs: `["redemption", share_mint, holder]`. Multi-transaction redeem (D9,
"above ~12 assets, two transactions"). Shares are burned and the pool
leg paid in `redeem_begin`; components are paid in one or more
`redeem_components` calls; the account closes when every position has
been paid.

fields.name: shares
docs: Net shares (after the redeem fee) this redemption is worth.

types.name: ReopenSchedule
docs: D6. Re-opens the gate for `open_s` seconds every `period_s` seconds
starting at `anchor_ts`. Only consulted when the gate is not `Open`.

types.name: SeedArgs
docs: `seed` (§5): the first buy. `deposits[i]` is the amount of position `i`
(book order) delivered in kind; `initial_shares` is the gross X the buyer
is paying for (the program never prices, D4); `sleeve_lamports` is the
SOL leg, `r·D` by the client's split. It must agree with the launch bin:
`sleeve_lamports ≈ Y × price(launch_active_id)` within one bin step.

fields.name: step_r_bps
docs: `r` during the step phase (D5: 25%).

fields.name: step_threshold_lamports
docs: Pool SOL side at which the step phase ends (D5: 20 SOL).

fields.name: profiles
docs: Indexed by `PROFILE_*`.

fields.name: r_bps
docs: After the step phase.

fields.name: default_r_bps
docs: Default `r` after the step phase.

types.name: TierAttestation
docs: Q10: keeper-signed leaderboard tier, verified by the ed25519 precompile
over `borsh(TierMessage)`. Missing or expired → tier 0.

fields.name: tier
docs: Liquidity tier, 0 = deepest. Informational for now.

constants.name: BASKET_TYPE_FIXED
docs: Basket kinds, matching `BasketType` in `packages/core`.

constants.name: BPS_TOTAL
docs: Weights are expressed in basis points and must sum to exactly this.

constants.name: FIXED_KIND_INDEX
docs: `fixed_kind` in `CreateBasketArgs`, Fixed baskets only.

constants.name: HOST_WEIGHTING_EQUAL
docs: Host weighting, Mirror only. Matches `HostWeighting` in `packages/core`.

constants.name: MAX_ASSETS_FIXED
docs: Only Fixed baskets cap the asset count (D20).

constants.name: PROFILE_FIXED_INDEX
docs: Sleeve / pool-preset profile (change order §2.1, progress §6.4a). Fixed
baskets pick one of two profiles in the payload (`fixed_kind`); the
other types map 1:1.

constants.name: SHARE_DECIMALS
docs: Share mint decimals (D1: classic SPL).
